b2-brasilinterior-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Capital
b2-brasilinterior-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip and reading about Brasília, and she asks whether the city was built slowly.
b2-brasilinterior-01.prompt: Tell Meg that the city was built so fast that it was inaugurated in 1960.
cues: Say that it was built fast
Use *tan ... que* and give the year
b2-brasilinterior-01.target: La ciudad se construyó tan rápido que se inauguró en 1960.
b2-brasilinterior-01.english: The city was built so fast that it was inaugurated in 1960.
b2-brasilinterior-01.canDo: I can say how much, or in what way, something happened and what resulted, with *tan ... que*, *tanto ... que* and *de tal manera que*, about Brasília.

b2-brasilinterior-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rubber and the Theatre
b2-brasilinterior-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Manaus, and he asks what happened to the city when rubber lost its price.
b2-brasilinterior-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened to the economy of the region when the price of rubber fell.
cues: Say the economy went into crisis
b2-brasilinterior-02.target: Cuando bajó el precio del caucho, la economía de la región entró en crisis.
b2-brasilinterior-02.english: When the price of rubber fell, the economy of the region went into crisis.
b2-brasilinterior-02.canDo: I can link two events or two actions in the Amazon with *cuando* and *mientras*.

b2-brasilinterior-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Xingu Park
b2-brasilinterior-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a talk on indigenous lands, and she asks what the Villas-Bôas brothers achieved.
b2-brasilinterior-03.prompt: Tell Meg that the brothers were to create the Xingu Park in 1961, using the formal pattern.
b2-brasilinterior-03.target: Los hermanos Villas-Bôas habían de crear el Parque del Xingu en 1961.
b2-brasilinterior-03.english: The Villas-Bôas brothers were to create the Xingu Park in 1961.
b2-brasilinterior-03.canDo: I can state a duty or a story's "was to" formally with *haber de* + infinitive, about indigenous lands.

b2-brasilinterior-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Soy and Water
b2-brasilinterior-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading about the Cerrado, and he says it was always a rich farming region.
b2-brasilinterior-04.prompt: Correct Carlos: for centuries it was thought poor, but today it produces a lot of soy, as a comparison.
cues: Say that it was thought poor
b2-brasilinterior-04.target: Durante siglos se consideró una región pobre; hoy, en cambio, produce mucha soja.
b2-brasilinterior-04.english: For centuries it was considered a poor region; today, on the other hand, it produces a lot of soy.
b2-brasilinterior-04.canDo: I can set one idea about the Cerrado against another with *en cambio*, *por el contrario*, *al contrario*, *no obstante* and *ahora bien*.

b2-brasilinterior-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Bridge and Roads
b2-brasilinterior-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are following the news about the bioceanic corridor, and she asks whether the road is finished.
b2-brasilinterior-05.prompt: Tell Meg that the bridge was joined in July 2026 but the access roads are due in 2027.
cues: Contrast it with the access roads, using *aunque*
b2-brasilinterior-05.target: Aunque el puente se unió en julio de 2026, los accesos terminarán en 2027.
b2-brasilinterior-05.english: Although the bridge was joined in July 2026, the access roads will be finished in 2027.
b2-brasilinterior-05.canDo: I can set facts against each other with *sin embargo*, *aunque* and *no obstante*, about Brazil and its neighbours.

b2-brasilinterior-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Brazil's Interior in Review
b2-brasilinterior-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are preparing a short talk about Brazil's interior, and he asks what you remember about Brasília.
b2-brasilinterior-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that the city grew so much that more people live in the satellite cities than in the Pilot Plan.
cues: Say that the city grew a lot
b2-brasilinterior-consolidation.target: La ciudad creció tanto que hoy vive más gente en las ciudades satélite que en el Plano Piloto.
b2-brasilinterior-consolidation.english: The city grew so much that more people now live in the satellite cities than in the Pilot Plan.
b2-brasilinterior-consolidation.canDo: I can review what I learned about Brasília, the Amazon, the Cerrado and Itamaraty.
